//: The regression fixture: a known-good design that must stay clean. FROZEN on purpose — it is the smart bin as it stood on the ESP32-C6, and the pin choices in it were expensive to learn. It is deliberately NOT tracked against the live project: a fixture that follows a project breaks every time the project is fixed, which teaches everyone to ignore it.
//board: A board id, resolved from the library by scripts/boards.py. It used to be a relative path into a sibling checkout, which stopped existing the moment the definitions moved into this plugin - and nothing noticed, because the test passes the board in separately.
